Disepiment

Diaphragm.
It is like
a partition
or wall that causes
the cells or chambers to remain
divided from one another.
When it extends to the middle
of the valves or ventricles
of the pericarp,
it is called Disepiment
or Diaphragm,
contrary or opposite: but if it runs
parallel to the valves,
it is called so parallel,

in the union of the two valves.
It also happens that these

they are called valvae medio-septiferae.
In the legume are seen some false
